armory.oathbound.arcanist_robe.name: Arcanist Regalia
armory.oathbound.arcanist_robe.note: Light, but not armour for a knight.
armory.oathbound.arcanist_robe.text: Robes of the Spire, sewn from spellsilk. The full regalia halves the cooldowns of the Order's arts and lets you drift gently when you sneak mid-air.
armory.oathbound.dawnbreaker.name: Dawnbreaker
armory.oathbound.dawnbreaker.text: The blade that ended the Hollow King. Hold it high to gather light, then let it go in a *Dawn Rite* that strikes the Gloam and the undead threefold.
armory.oathbound.dawnstring_longbow.name: Dawnstring Longbow
armory.oathbound.dawnstring_longbow.note: Sunmarked foes glow and take 30% more damage.
armory.oathbound.dawnstring_longbow.text: A bow strung with spellsilk and light. A full draw looses a sun-arrow that pierces and *Sunmarks* what it strikes.
armory.oathbound.drowned_anchor.name: The Drowned Anchor
armory.oathbound.drowned_anchor.text: Sir Caldris's anchor. Thrown on its chain it hooks a creature and hauls it to you, or bites into stone and hauls you after it.
armory.oathbound.everflame_lantern.name: The Everflame Lantern
armory.oathbound.everflame_lantern.note: Some oaths are worth keeping after all.
armory.oathbound.everflame_lantern.text: The Order's own lantern, rekindled with an ember of the first dawn and the insignia of its fallen knights. It never gutters.
armory.oathbound.hollow_crown.name: The Hollow Crown
armory.oathbound.hollow_crown.note: You never swore on it. That is why it is safe.
armory.oathbound.hollow_crown.text: Morvane's crown, empty now. It grants sight in the dark, a little more life, and the Gloam's creatures will not trouble its wearer unless provoked.
armory.oathbound.housecarl_warhorn.name: Housecarl's Warhorn
armory.oathbound.housecarl_warhorn.note: They will not strike you, whatever you do.
armory.oathbound.housecarl_warhorn.text: Hrodgar's horn. Sounded, it calls two Spectral Housecarls to fight beside you for forty seconds.
armory.oathbound.lumen_flask.name: Lumen Flask
armory.oathbound.lumen_flask.note: Three from one measure of luminous dust.
armory.oathbound.lumen_flask.text: A glass of light. Thrown, it bursts, blinding and burning Gloam creatures and leaving wisplights hanging in the air.
armory.oathbound.oathkey.name: The Oathkey
armory.oathbound.oathkey.note: Set it in the Sundered Keystone.
armory.oathbound.oathkey.text: The three seals bound into one key. It opens the Sundered Gate, and nothing else.
armory.oathbound.oathsteel_longsword.not: Oathsteel mends itself slowly in the sun.
armory.oathbound.oathsteel_longsword.tex: A patient blade. Every wound you take in the three seconds before you swing is added to the blow as a *Riposte*.
armory.oathbound.shadowreap_sickle.name: Shadowreap Sickle
armory.oathbound.shadowreap_sickle.note: In daylight it is only a sickle.
armory.oathbound.shadowreap_sickle.text: A sickle that drinks the dark. The less light around what it strikes, the harder the blow and the more of it returns to you as health.
armory.oathbound.staff_of_veyl.name: Staff of Veyl
armory.oathbound.staff_of_veyl.text: The Archmage's staff. It looses an *Arcane Chain* that leaps from foe to foe, up to five, weakening with every leap.
armory.oathbound.wardens_halberd.name: Warden's Halberd
armory.oathbound.wardens_halberd.note: Oathsteel mends itself slowly in the sun.
armory.oathbound.wardens_halberd.text: A long reach, and a sprinting strike that drives through every foe in a line.
armory.oathbound.wardens_lantern.name: Warden's Lantern
armory.oathbound.wardens_lantern.note: Feed it lumenite shards when it runs low.
armory.oathbound.wardens_lantern.text: The lantern every knight of the Order carried. Held, it keeps a wisplight burning at your head, wakes Hymn Stones and relights Ward Lanterns. Used, it *Seeks* the next place the Chronicle would send you.
bestiary.oathbound.animated_tome.name: Animated Tome
bestiary.oathbound.animated_tome.text: Grimoires of the Arcanist's Spire that learned to fly after their readers stopped reading. They flit erratically and loose glyph bolts.
bestiary.oathbound.archmage_veyl.name: Archmage Veyl
bestiary.oathbound.archmage_veyl.note: His orbs can be struck back at him. Of his reflections, only the real one's staff burns gold.
bestiary.oathbound.archmage_veyl.text: The Order's master of wards, who bound his own mind into the Seal of Wisdom. He blinks, he mirrors himself, and his gravity glyphs lift the ground from under you.
bestiary.oathbound.barrow_wight.name: Barrow Wight
bestiary.oathbound.barrow_wight.note: Their Grave Chill slows you and dulls your pick.
bestiary.oathbound.barrow_wight.text: Grave-spirits of the Barrow of Kings, drifting in the burial cloth they were laid out in. Their touch carries the cold of the tomb.
bestiary.oathbound.forsworn_knight.name: Forsworn Knight
bestiary.oathbound.forsworn_knight.note: Only oathsteel, fire or light lays them to rest.
bestiary.oathbound.forsworn_knight.text: Knights of the Order who followed Morvane into the dark. Their oaths are broken, but their armour will not lie still: strike one down and it rises again.
bestiary.oathbound.gloamling.name: Gloamling
bestiary.oathbound.gloamling.note: They burn in daylight. Hold a lit lantern to see them clearly.
bestiary.oathbound.gloamling.text: Imps of the dusk that seep out of the Gloaming at night. In darkness they are almost invisible; only a lantern's light holds them to a shape. They strike and scatter, giggling.
bestiary.oathbound.hrodgar.name: Hrodgar
bestiary.oathbound.hrodgar.note: Jump the shockwaves. At the end, he will try to devour his own guard to heal.
bestiary.oathbound.hrodgar.text: The first Barrow-King, a giant who returned from the grave to give his oath. His flail breaks the earth into rings of force; his housecarls rise to shield him.
bestiary.oathbound.lanternmoth.name: Lanternmoth
bestiary.oathbound.lanternmoth.note: They shed *Luminous Dust*, the heart of lumen flasks and the Elixir of Dawn.
bestiary.oathbound.lanternmoth.text: A gentle moth whose abdomen glows like a lantern-flame. They drift through woodland at night and gather around anyone carrying a light. The Order took them as its heraldic beast.
bestiary.oathbound.morvane.name: Morvane
bestiary.oathbound.morvane.note: When the Ward Lanterns go out, light all four again to Unveil him.
bestiary.oathbound.morvane.text: The Hollow King. Once Lord-Commander of the Order; now armour with a void inside it, crowned with a promise that was a lie. He duels, then sorcerers, then hides in the dark.
bestiary.oathbound.sir_caldris.name: Sir Caldris
bestiary.oathbound.sir_caldris.note: Flank him, or break his guard with an axe. At half strength he calls drowned squires.
bestiary.oathbound.sir_caldris.text: The Tide-Knight of the Drowned Chapel, still standing his vigil beneath the water. His tower shield turns every frontal blow. His anchor drags the unwary into his reach.
bestiary.oathbound.spectral_housecarl.no: While tethered to Hrodgar, they shield him.
bestiary.oathbound.spectral_housecarl.te: Hrodgar's oath-sworn guards, who would not leave their king even in death. They fight for him still, and for whoever sounds his horn.
bestiary.oathbound.veilhound.name: Veilhound
bestiary.oathbound.veilhound.note: Keep a wall at your back.
bestiary.oathbound.veilhound.text: Pack-hunters of the Gloaming, darker than their own shadows. They circle, testing, and lunge from several sides at once.

chronicle.oathbound.lore.0:
You were a squire of the *Order of the Ember Lantern* for one night. Then the Order was gone, and only this book remained, warm in your hands as if someone had just been reading it.

The _Lanternguard_ were knight-wizards who carried the *Everflame*, a fire kindled at the first dawn. For four hundred years they kept the night from coming too far into the world. Their towers are ruins now; their wayshrines are cold.

Begin where they began. Find *lumenite* in the stone, where sunlight fell and stayed. Blend it with iron and forge *Oathsteel*. Build a _Warden's Lantern_ and carry it to a *Wayshrine*. Kindle the brazier. The Order will know you.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.1:
The kindled wayshrine burned for a long time after you left it, and the Chronicle turned its own pages that night.

_Sir Caldris_ was the Order's Tide-Knight, who swore that no tide would ever reach the chapel where the Order kept its vows. The sea came anyway. He is still there, beneath the water-dark nave, keeping the *Seal of Valor* for a war that ended four centuries ago.

The drowned chapel has a *Hymn Stone*. It sings only to a Warden's light. Learn its hymn and ring the chapel bells in that order; the crypt will open. Mind his tower shield: Caldris does not turn his back.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.2:
With the Seal of Valor in your pack the Chronicle wrote in a new hand, thin and precise.

_Archmage Veyl_ taught the Order its wards. When the three bound the Hollow King, Veyl bound his own mind into the *Seal of Wisdom*, so the seal could never forget what it held. He has not forgotten. He has not slept, either.

His spire answers only to those who solve his *Cipher*: four riddles, four glyphs, four dials. The ward before his sanctum will not so much as flicker for anyone who has not first proven their valor. Watch for the one of him whose staff burns gold.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.3:
The Chronicle's pages smell of earth now.

_Hrodgar_ was the first of the Barrow-Kings, dead two hundred years before the Order fell. When the three needed a third oath, he returned from his tomb to give it, and the *Seal of Sacrifice* is sealed with his death as much as his life.

Three other kings sleep in his barrow, and their epitaphs disagree. *Exactly one of them told the truth.* Kneel at the honest king's tomb and Hrodgar's hall will open. Kneel at a liar's, and the barrow will answer.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.4:
Three seals. One key.

The *Oathkey* is the three oaths bound into one: valor, wisdom and sacrifice. The *Sundered Citadel*, where the Order fell in a single night, still holds the gate the three used to shut Morvane out of the world.

Find the citadel. Set the Oathkey into the *Sundered Keystone*. Then step through the veil, into the _Gloaming_: the grey country between dusk and night. Keep your lantern lit there. Those who walk the Gloaming without light begin to fade.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.5:
_Morvane_ was the Lord-Commander of the Order of the Ember Lantern. He feared death more than he loved anything, and in the Gloaming he found the *Hollow Crown*, which promised a reign without end to whoever swore upon it.

He swore, and he lied, and the Gloam poured through him. He is not a man any more. He is armour with a void inside it, sitting a throne on the highest island of the grey country, ringed by four *Ward Lanterns*.

When the lanterns gutter and the dark takes him, light them again. Nothing hides from the Everflame for long.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.6:
Not everything the Order left behind is on the road to the throne.

Lanternguard knights hid their *insignia* in their strongholds, behind brickwork that looks a little too cracked. Their *tablets* still stand in the ruins, each carved with a piece of the Order's history. The creatures of the world have their own stories too.

The Chronicle keeps all of it. Turn its pages when the road is quiet.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.epilogue:
The Hollow Crown cracked, and light came out of it: four hundred years of stolen dawns, all at once.

The Gloaming is still there, between dusk and night, but it is only grey now, not hungry. The veil will open for you whenever you wish. The Everflame is yours to rekindle, if you can gather the insignia of the Order you never got to join.

The Chronicle has one page left, and it is blank. It is waiting for you to write the Order's next oath.

item.oathbound.drowned_anchor.desc.3: hooks a creature and hauls it to you, or hauls you to the stone it bites.

item.oathbound.everflame_ember.desc.1: A coal of the first dawn, won back from the Hollow King.
item.oathbound.everflame_ember.desc.2: Warm enough to kindle the Everflame Lantern.
item.oathbound.everflame_lantern.desc.3: Seeks, lights and wards like a Warden's Lantern.
item.oathbound.gloam_essence.desc.1: A little of the grey country, cold to the touch.
item.oathbound.hollow_crown.desc.1: Morvane swore on it. Nothing wears it now.
item.oathbound.hollow_crown.desc.2: Night vision. Gloam creatures leave you be unless struck.
item.oathbound.honeyed_mead.desc.1: The Order's own. Regeneration and a golden warmth; mind the spinning.
item.oathbound.housecarl_warhorn.desc.2: Sound it to call two Spectral Housecarls to fight beside you for 40s.
item.oathbound.knights_stew.desc.1: A meal to march on: Resistance and Strength.
item.oathbound.lantern_chronicle.desc.1: The living book of the Lanternguard. It chose you.
item.oathbound.lantern_chronicle.desc.2: Use to open. It remembers what you do.
item.oathbound.lanternguard_insignia.des: A knight's badge: a lantern on a shield.

item.oathbound.lumen_flask.desc.2: Throw to burst in blinding light that burns Gloam creatures and leaves wisplights.
item.oathbound.lumenite_dust.desc.1: It glitters even in a closed fist.
item.oathbound.lumenite_shard.desc.1: Sunlight that fell into the stone and stayed.
item.oathbound.lumenite_shard.desc.2: Use with a Warden's Lantern in the other hand to refuel it.
item.oathbound.luminous_dust.desc.1: Shed by lanternmoths. It never quite stops glowing.
item.oathbound.oathkey.desc.1: Three oaths bound into one key.
item.oathbound.oathkey.desc.2: Use on the Sundered Keystone to open the Gate.

item.oathbound.seal_of_valor.desc.1: Given up by Sir Caldris of the Drowned Chapel.

item.oathbound.seal_of_wisdom.desc.2: One of the three seals of the Oathkey.
item.oathbound.shadowreap_sickle.desc.2: The darker the place, the harder it strikes and the more it heals you.
item.oathbound.spellsilk.desc.1: Woven on looms that were never touched by hands.

message.oathbound.morvane.phase3: The Ward Lanterns go out. The Hollow King becomes the dark itself. Light them!
message.oathbound.morvane.unveiled: All four lanterns blaze! Morvane is UNVEILED.
message.oathbound.morvane.wake: The lanterns gutter, one by one. On the throne, something that was a man lifts its head.

message.oathbound.seek.none: The lantern has nowhere left to lead you. Your road is your own.

message.oathbound.tomb.liar: %s lied, even in death. His barrow wakes!
message.oathbound.tomb.wisdom: You kneel, but the tomb does not know you. Return with the Seal of Wisdom.
message.oathbound.ward.hint: An arcane ward. Somewhere in this place is the answer that dissolves it.

message.oathbound.wayshrine.blessing: The shrine's warmth settles on you.
message.oathbound.wayshrine.hint: Kindle the brazier with a lit Warden's Lantern in your hand.
message.oathbound.wayshrine.kindled: The wayshrine takes the flame. Somewhere, the Order remembers.
message.oathbound.wayshrine.no_tithes: The Order owes you nothing yet.

quest.oathbound.citadel.description: Find the ruin where the Order fell.
quest.oathbound.citadel.hint: It is rare, and far. Seek with your lantern.
quest.oathbound.citadel.title: The Sundered Citadel
quest.oathbound.crown.hint: It will not hurt you. You never swore on it.
quest.oathbound.crown.title: Uneasy Lies the Head
quest.oathbound.dawnbreaker.title: The First Light, Forged
quest.oathbound.dawnstring.title: Strung with Light
quest.oathbound.elixir.hint: A bottle, luminous dust, gloam essence and a golden carrot.
quest.oathbound.elixir.title: Drink the Morning
quest.oathbound.everflame.hint: Four insignia around a Warden's Lantern, with Everflame Embers.
quest.oathbound.everflame.title: The Everflame Rekindled
quest.oathbound.flask.title: Light, Corked
quest.oathbound.forsworn.description: Lay a Forsworn Knight to rest for good.
quest.oathbound.forsworn.hint: They rise again unless the last blow is oathsteel, fire or light.
quest.oathbound.forsworn.title: Rest for the Forsworn
quest.oathbound.gate.description: Set the Oathkey in the Sundered Keystone and open the Gate.
quest.oathbound.gate.hint: Use the Oathkey on the keystone at the heart of the citadel.
quest.oathbound.gate.title: Open the Sundered Gate
quest.oathbound.gloaming.description: Step through the veil into the grey country.
quest.oathbound.gloaming.hint: Keep a lantern lit, or drink an Elixir of Dawn.
quest.oathbound.gloaming.title: Into the Gloaming
quest.oathbound.gloamling.hint: Hold a lit lantern: they cannot hide in its light.
quest.oathbound.gloamling.title: Things that Giggle in the Dark
quest.oathbound.honest_king.description: Read the three epitaphs and kneel at the tomb of the only king who told the truth.
quest.oathbound.honest_king.hint: Exactly one epitaph is true. Sneak and use the tomb to kneel. You must carry the Seal of Wisdom.
quest.oathbound.honest_king.title: One of Three Told the Truth
quest.oathbound.hrodgar.description: Defeat Hrodgar and take back the Seal of Sacrifice.
quest.oathbound.hrodgar.hint: Jump his flail's shockwaves. Break the tethers of his housecarls before you strike at him.
quest.oathbound.hrodgar.title: The Barrow-King
quest.oathbound.hymn.description: Learn the Hymn Stone's song by lantern-light, then ring the chapel bells in its order.
quest.oathbound.hymn.hint: Read the Hymn Stone with a lit lantern. A wrong note starts the hymn over.
quest.oathbound.hymn.title: The Hymn of the Tide
quest.oathbound.insignia.hint: Every stronghold hides one behind cracked brickwork.
quest.oathbound.insignia.title: A Knight's Badge
quest.oathbound.lantern.description: Craft the lantern every knight of the Order carried.
quest.oathbound.lantern.hint: Nuggets around a lumenite shard, on an oathsteel ingot.
quest.oathbound.lantern.title: The Warden's Lantern
quest.oathbound.lanternmoth.hint: They drift through woods at night, drawn to your light.
quest.oathbound.lanternmoth.title: Moths to a Lantern
quest.oathbound.loremaster.hint: They stand in the Order's ruins, one or two in each.
quest.oathbound.loremaster.title: Keeper of the Chronicle
quest.oathbound.lumenite.description: Mine Lumenite Ore, which glows faintly in the deep rock.
quest.oathbound.lumenite.hint: Lumenite is found from deep below up to about y 56. An iron pickaxe or better.
quest.oathbound.lumenite.title: Sunlight in Stone
quest.oathbound.morvane.description: Break the Hollow Crown. Defeat Morvane.
quest.oathbound.morvane.hint: When the lanterns go out, light them again. All four lit leaves him Unveiled.
quest.oathbound.morvane.title: The Hollow King
quest.oathbound.oathkey.description: Bind the three seals into the Oathkey.
quest.oathbound.oathkey.hint: The three seals around an oathsteel ingot, over gold.
quest.oathbound.oathkey.title: Three Oaths, One Key
quest.oathbound.oathsteel.description: Blend iron with lumenite and smelt the blend into an Oathsteel Ingot.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel.hint: Oathsteel Blend: 1 iron ingot + 2 lumenite shards, shapeless. Smelt it.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel.title: Forge Oathsteel
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_armor.descript: Forge any piece of Oathsteel armour.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_armor.title: The Knight's Harness
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_arms.descripti: Forge an Oathsteel Longsword or a Warden's Halberd.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_arms.hint: Both are made from oathsteel and sticks.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_arms.title: Oath-Forged Arms
quest.oathbound.root.description: Open the Chronicle. Its pages will fill as you walk the Order's road.
quest.oathbound.root.hint: Right-click the Chronicle to open it.
quest.oathbound.root.title: The Lantern Chronicle
quest.oathbound.sickle.hint: Oathsteel, gloam essence and a stick.
quest.oathbound.sickle.title: It Drinks the Dark
quest.oathbound.spellsilk.hint: Animated Tomes shed it; the spire's shelves hold more.
quest.oathbound.spellsilk.title: Woven Without Hands
quest.oathbound.spire.description: Find the Arcanist's Spire in the forests or the northern woods.
quest.oathbound.spire.title: The Hollow Spire
quest.oathbound.throne.description: Climb to the Hollow Throne and challenge the King.
quest.oathbound.throne.hint: The throne stands on the Gloaming's high island.
quest.oathbound.throne.title: The Hollow Throne
quest.oathbound.veilhound.hint: They circle before they strike. Keep your back to something.
quest.oathbound.veilhound.title: The Hounds of the Veil
quest.oathbound.veyl.description: Defeat Archmage Veyl and take back the Seal of Wisdom.
quest.oathbound.veyl.hint: Strike his orbs back at him. Of his mirror images, the real Veyl's staff burns gold.
quest.oathbound.veyl.title: The Hollow Magus
quest.oathbound.warhorn.title: The Housecarls' Call
quest.oathbound.wayshrine.description: Find one of the Order's roadside wayshrines and kindle its brazier with your lantern.
quest.oathbound.wayshrine.hint: Use the lantern to Seek. Kindle the brazier with the lantern lit in your hand.
quest.oathbound.wayshrine.title: Kindle a Wayshrine
riddle.oathbound.0.0: I am carried into the dark so that the dark may be carried out.
riddle.oathbound.0.1: I have a heart of fire and a body of iron, and I hang from a hand.
riddle.oathbound.1.0: Two roads meet in me, and neither ends.
riddle.oathbound.1.1: I am where the sword and the oath cross.
riddle.oathbound.2.0: Break me, and what I held is free.
riddle.oathbound.2.1: I am pressed in wax and in stone, and I keep what I close.
riddle.oathbound.3.0: I have walls but no rooms, and I am the last to fall.
riddle.oathbound.3.1: Four towers, one heart; the siege ends when I do.
riddle.oathbound.4.0: I see only what is lit, and I am the first thing a ward must fool.
riddle.oathbound.4.1: I open at dawn and close at dusk, and I weep.
riddle.oathbound.5.0: I sat on the head of a man who lied, and I was empty.
riddle.oathbound.5.1: I have points but no edge, and a king under me.
tablet.oathbound.0.1: Before the first morning there was only the grey,
tablet.oathbound.0.2: and in the grey a single ember that would not go out.
tablet.oathbound.0.3: The first knights carried it out into the world
tablet.oathbound.0.title: The First Dawn
tablet.oathbound.1.1: We swear to carry light where it is needed,
tablet.oathbound.1.2: to walk first into the dark,
tablet.oathbound.1.3: to keep no flame for ourselves alone.
tablet.oathbound.1.4: So swore every squire. So swore Morvane.
tablet.oathbound.1.title: The Order of the Ember Lantern
tablet.oathbound.2.1: Where the road is long, kindle a shrine.
tablet.oathbound.2.2: Where a shrine is kindled, the Order is fed.
tablet.oathbound.2.3: A cold shrine is a knight who did not come home.
tablet.oathbound.2.title: On Wayshrines
tablet.oathbound.3.1: Caldris swore the tide would not take the chapel.
tablet.oathbound.3.3: He stood in the nave until the water closed over his helm,
tablet.oathbound.3.4: and he is standing there still.
tablet.oathbound.3.5: Some oaths are kept past all reason.
tablet.oathbound.3.title: The Tide-Knight
tablet.oathbound.4.1: A ward is a question the dark cannot answer.
tablet.oathbound.4.2: Ask it well, and ask it forever.
tablet.oathbound.4.3: I have bound my own mind into this seal
tablet.oathbound.4.4: so that the question will never be forgotten.
tablet.oathbound.4.title: The Archmage's Maxim
tablet.oathbound.5.1: Hrodgar was two hundred years dead when we called him.
tablet.oathbound.5.2: He came, and he gave his oath,
tablet.oathbound.5.3: and he lay down again under the green mound.
tablet.oathbound.5.4: His housecarls would not leave him.
tablet.oathbound.5.5: They are there yet, and so is he.
tablet.oathbound.5.title: The Barrow-King
tablet.oathbound.6.1: The Lord-Commander came back from the Gloaming wearing a crown.
tablet.oathbound.6.2: By midnight the lanterns were out.
tablet.oathbound.6.3: By dawn there was no Order left to raise them.
tablet.oathbound.6.4: Only three of us still had our oaths.
tablet.oathbound.6.title: The Night of Ash
tablet.oathbound.7.3: Sacrifice to pay for the lock.
tablet.oathbound.7.4: Three seals, one key, and a gate that must never open
tablet.oathbound.7.5: unless the Order returns to close it for good.
tablet.oathbound.7.title: The Binding
tablet.oathbound.8.1: Between dusk and night there is a country
tablet.oathbound.8.2: where nothing is born and nothing quite dies.
tablet.oathbound.8.3: Carry light there, or it will take the colour out of you
tablet.oathbound.8.title: The Grey Country
tablet.oathbound.9.1: If you are reading this, the Chronicle has chosen.
tablet.oathbound.9.2: We are sorry to leave you so much work.
tablet.oathbound.9.3: Kindle the shrines. Keep the oaths.
tablet.oathbound.9.title: To the Last Squire
title.oathbound.caldris.slain.sub: Sir Caldris lays down his vigil at last
title.oathbound.gate.sub: The veil to the Gloaming hangs in the arch
